mentions.name: Rentier
mentions.description: A Monopoly-inspired board game rebuilt as a multi-part learning project, with a React frontend and a TypeScript game engine. The plan covers a postmortem of part 1, implementing postmortem findings in the TS engine, updating the React frontend, and rewriting the engine in Rust from scratch, with an emphasis on TDD, strong typing, and clean code.
mentions.source_excerpt:
The project is called "Rentier", a joke about the Monopoly board game.
